hero.lead: hanz Industry engineers and manufactures precision metal components and industrial assemblies for partners across construction, commercial vehicles, automotive, and heavy equipment.

capabilities.title: Everything between raw aluminum and a boxed part.
capabilities.lead: We don't outsource steps. One roof, one quality system, your part done right.

items.title: CNC Machining
items.body: Multi-axis milling and turning held to ±0.01 mm across steel, aluminium, and alloy stock.

items.title: Metal Fabrication
items.body: Laser cutting, forming, and certified welding for structural and precision assemblies.

items.title: Surface Treatment
items.body: Powder coating, anodizing, and galvanizing calibrated for corrosion and fatigue life.

items.title: Quality Assurance
items.body: In-house metrology, CMM inspection, and full material traceability on every batch.

steps.title: Analyze raw material
steps.body: We spectrograph-test every alloy batch — verifying chemical composition, purity, and mechanical properties before it enters the furnace.

steps.title: Plan the manufacturing
steps.body: Our engineering team selects the right die-casting machines, designs the tooling, and maps the full process route for your part.

steps.title: Inject the aluminum
steps.body: Molten aluminum is shot into precision dies under high pressure — filling complex geometries in milliseconds with repeatable accuracy.

steps.title: Produce at scale
steps.body: Automated die-casting cells run production batches with live quality gates, cycle-time tracking, and zero-defect targets.

steps.title: QC / QA & ship
steps.body: Every part is CMM-inspected, X-ray sampled, and certified before packing and logistics to your dock — on time.

philosophy.title: Tolerance is a promise, not a target.
philosophy.body: We treat every dimension on a drawing as a commitment. That discipline — measured, documented, and repeatable — is why partners return to us for the work that cannot fail.
